title.narrative: Enhancing Nigerian Advocacy for a Better Business Environment Programme (Procurement of Services)

description.narrative: This activity Enhancing Nigerian Advocacy for a Better Business Environment Programme (Procurement of Services) is a component of Enhancing Nigerian Advocacy for a Better Business Environment (ENABLE) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £11,939,712. It works in the following sector(s): Trade policy and administrative management, Research/scientific institutions, Privatisation, Small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) development, Information and communication technology (ICT).
